title: 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1RE: visits at a leftover 100 merge blocks or build new walls
text: A visit that passes a leftover 100 merges the blocks around it into S_(x+y+3) S_0 S_0 S_(z-1) while the next wall loses three 1s. This is proved for all counts with a fixed number of blocks, and exact on 90 of 90 such visits in the run. A visit that turns at the 100 leaves every second block it passes as a run of 1s; these are the new walls, and that case is still open.
